subject: Surge smoothing & deployment bump — interim pricing + amendment
messages:
From: Leah Torres <leah@stardrive.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stardrive.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term capacity bump and pricing ask

Hi Marissa,

We just kicked a new rollout that tripled inference traffic overnight. Ops asked me to reach out — we need an interim capacity path for the next 60 days while we finalize our forecast.

High level:
- Need +40% baseline capacity effective immediately
- Looking for a pricing approach that doesn’t require a full-term uplift or multi-year re-commitment
- Procurement will need an amendment/PO to process by next week

Can you share options (short-term credits, temporary bucket, or staged commit) and any playbook for co-terming this with our March renewal?

Thanks,
-Leah
Leah Torres
Head of Platform
Stardrive AI

Attachment: (none in this message)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leah Torres <leah@stardrive.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, procurement@stardrive.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity bump and pricing ask

Thanks Leah — sorry to hear about the surprise traffic spike. We can support this without forcing a long-term change; proposing three pragmatic options so procurement can choose what's fastest: 

Option 1 — Emergency surge bucket (fastest):
- One-off "surge" bucket equal to +40% baseline for 60 days
- 20% premium on unit rate for burst usage, invoiced next cycle
- No change to renewal term

Option 2 — Short-term credit with co-term path:
- Customer prepays for an uplift bucket (+30%) for 90 days
- We apply a 10% credit on the uplift purchase as a goodwill discount
- Commit converts to a co-term adjustment at renewal with pro-rated balance

Option 3 — Mid-contract uplift + limited discount (preferred for predictability):
- Increase committed capacity by +25% through renewal
- Apply a one-time uplift credit equal to 10% of the added commit (appears as invoice credit)
- No change to model tier or SLA

Next steps I recommend: a quick sync (30m) with procurement and ops to pick the path. If you want to move forward quickly, Ben can approve a one-time surge credit and I can draft an amendment for signature.

I'll attach a pricing workbook with the cost math and a sample amendment draft once Ben confirms.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: stardrive_uplift_pricing.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Leah Torres <leah@stardrive.ai>, procurement@stardrive.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T12:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity bump and pricing ask

Looping in from revenue ops — we can approve a limited surge concession. High-level constraints:
- One-time surge credit up to 15% on incremental consumption for first 60 days only
- Credit issued as invoice offset; must have PO by 2028-03-22
- Legal needs a short amendment (no changes to indemnity or data terms)

Marissa, please prepare the amendment draft and include the exact credit language and PO instructions. Leah, if procurement can confirm PO timeline and finance approver, we’ll lock this in.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Growth Sales
Redwood Inference

> On Mar 15, 2028, at 11:04 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > (pricing options and recommendation)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Torres <leah@stardrive.ai>, procurement@stardrive.ai
Date: 2028-03-16T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity bump and pricing ask

Ben — concur with the approach. Approve applying a 10% operational credit to the uplift purchase (not to exceed the 15% guideline Ben called out) with the following guardrails:
- Credit applies to incremental units consumed during the 60-day surge window only
- Customer must issue a PO referencing deal RD-2971 and the amendment by 2028-03-22
- Credit expires if PO not received by that date; standard rates apply retroactively

Marissa: please produce a short amendment that:
1) Adds a temporary surge bucket for +40% (or configurable units)
2) States the 10% credit application and expiration/PO clause
3) Keeps renewal untouched and explains conversion options at renewal (co-term or normal renewal)

Include the pricing workbook and a one-click DocuSign link. I want legal to look only for the PO clause; we should avoid a lengthy legal review.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: stardrive_amendment_draft.docx

From: Leah Torres <leah@stardrive.ai>

Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term capacity bump and pricing ask

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms we can get a PO to you by 2028-03-21; PO number will be SD-8831. For speed, we prefer Option 1 (surge bucket) with the credit guardrail you described.

Request for the amendment:
- Short form amendment with the surge bucket table and explicit expiration
- Include invoice flow and PO number field
- Return via DocuSign; will share with finance for signature once PO is issued

Can you also confirm whether the surge bucket will be visible in our Console usage view and whether it affects alerting thresholds? Ops wants visibility.

-Leah
Leah Torres
